title: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not perform authorisation or a valid…
description: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions before 1.6.0 contains a vulnerability in its ticket-transfer feature. This feature lacks proper authorization and nonce validation, allowing unauthenticated users to transfer guest-checkout tickets belonging to other attendees. This unauthorized transfer invalidates the legitimate ticket and causes the victim's ticket PDF, which includes personal attendee data, to be sent to the attacker.
